verifiedRules.value: After original term courses are completed, additional courses may be added with the Program Mentor. Completion speed depends on mastery and assessment completion.

verifiedRules.caution: Programmatic limits and actual eligible course mappings may be lower. Do not treat 75 percent as a guaranteed course award.

verifiedRules.value: No transfer awards after the initial WGU term starts.
Official transcripts should arrive by the fifth day of the month before the intended start.
Each original issuing institution must send its own official record; transfer credit merely copied onto another transcript is not accepted as original evidence.

unresolvedOrScoped.observed: The current official indexed BS Business Management guide says at least25percent of required Degree Competency Units excluding the capstone must be completed at WGU. Neither full handbook retrieval nor a primary worked formula was available.
unresolvedOrScoped.action: Do not infer a flat minimum: excluding the4CU capstone from a110CU denominator produces30.5CU including capstone, while excluding capstone only from the eligible numerator produces31.5CU. These are mathematical interpretations, not asserted WGU decisions. A proposed route retaining at least32WGUCU satisfies both readings; retain the exact policy ambiguity for maximum-transfer optimization.

unresolvedOrScoped.observed: The transfer marketing page includes a first-of-month summary but detailed deadline and November catalog specify the fifth.
unresolvedOrScoped.action: Use the catalog fifth-day deadline; advise earlier receipt rather than presenting the summary discrepancy as a later deadline.

unresolvedOrScoped.action: Bind pricing to currentNovember catalog effectiveOct1,2026; do not use stale directory cards.

unresolvedOrScoped.observed: Six months is the billing term, not a guaranteed degree duration.
unresolvedOrScoped.action: Show one-term completion only as an explicit student-pace scenario.

reviewedResidencyPolicy.publishedWording: at least 25% of the required Degree Competency Units (excluding the capstone course) at WGU

conservativeSufficientCondition.derivation: 0.25 × 110 = 27.5 noncapstone WGU competency units; the required 4-CU capstone is additional. This is a sufficient planning check under both identified readings, not a claim that WGU publishes a 31.5-CU minimum.

notes: The indexed university transfer guideline excludes the capstone but does not provide a worked numerator/denominator example. Do not substitute a guessed institutionalMinCredits or a 30-semester-credit residency rule.
A plan satisfying this sufficient condition and completing QGT1 at WGU meets both identified interpretations; the precise maximum-transfer floor remains unresolved.

reviewedAggregatePolicyResolution.message: The complete 36-course, 110-CU BSMGT 202605 curriculum is enforced through named receiving requirements. A separate semester upper-level aggregate is not assumed; this does not remove named-course eligibility, current transfer restrictions or required WGU coursework.
